snippet.title: Unmurk - Trailer #2
snippet.description:
You only see the outer edges of the puzzle. Put the puzzles back into place to reveal a hidden voxel object.

The game is currently in development and will be released in 2023 on the App Store and Steam. In the meantime, you can add the game to your wishlist on Steam. :)

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1923960/Unmurk/
